title: RSVP ERP dataset for authentication from Zhang et al 2025
description: A longitudinal EEG dataset comprising event-related potentials (ERPs) from 15 healthy participants performing a rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) face authentication task. The dataset includes 4 sessions per subject collected over 200 days, with 57-channel EEG recordings at 1000 Hz sampling rate. Participants discriminated between self-face and AI-generated faces in a p300-based identity authentication paradigm, yielding approximately 160 target and 6240 non-target trials per session. This derivative dataset was generated from raw EEG data using MOABB 1.5.0 and is organized in BIDS format.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuracle Neusen system with 57 electrodes in a standard 10-20 montage (reference: CPz, ground: AFz). Participants performed an RSVP face authentication task with visual stimulus presentation at 100 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. The experimental protocol consisted of 4 sessions over 200 days, with each session containing 4 blocks of 8 sequences presenting 200 face images. Data were sampled at 1000 Hz with a 50 Hz line frequency. Raw EEG data were processed and organized into BIDS-compliant derivative format using MOABB 1.5.0 (Mother of All BCI Benchmarks).
